shots.title: Scope workflow-step-gate to the active sprint and ignore completed or merged sprint executions (#668)

hazards.description: [code review] Weak roadmap inference could override an explicit sprint branch and fail open

shots.notes: Made active sprint-state and explicit branch identity authoritative over stale workflow executions and weak roadmap inference.

shots.title: Include blocking sprint id and execution id in workflow-step-gate error output (#668)
shots.notes: Guard diagnostics now identify the blocking sprint and workflow execution directly.

shots.title: Finalize or reconcile the current sprint execution when validation/review closes the sprint lifecycle (#668)

hazards.description: A legacy workflow-gate test used repository-local fake state and mutated the live shared sprint-state file during the full suite.
[architect review] Validation could complete the workflow execution that invoked it before the workflow engine recorded validation
[architect review] List-then-unconditional closeout could overwrite a concurrent paused or failed transition
[code review] Protected roadmap dispositions could still make workflow executions eligible for completion
[code review] Same-millisecond workflow starts could preserve an older execution while completing an equally new peer
[code review] Required atomic closeout on the base store interface broke compatible custom adapters

shots.notes: Validation preserves its invoking execution, closes stale duplicates with atomic compare-and-set transitions, and post-merge completes any remaining current execution.

shots.title: Route post-merge retro evidence through the repository state owner with linked-worktree regression coverage (#673)

hazards.description: The first linked-worktree assertion compared macOS /var and /private/var spellings instead of canonical paths.
[code review] No-op capability negotiation failed compatible stores and post-merge reported failure after durable writes

shots.notes: Post-merge retro, memories, sprint-state reconciliation, and workflow closeout resolve through the primary repository state owner.

conditions.description: Multiple concurrent workflow executions and linked worktrees share lifecycle state, so weak inference and unconditional writes are unsafe.

training.description: Lifecycle closeout needs both authoritative scope selection and an atomic terminal transition.
training.outcome: Closeout now preserves the caller, filters protected dispositions, and uses adapter-level compare-and-set completion.

nutrition.description: 259 test files passed; 4,324 tests passed and 27 were skipped.
TypeScript typecheck and the root plus pi-extension production build passed on Node 22.
The primary sprint-state SHA-256 remained unchanged across the complete test suite.

bunker_locations: Do not infer a sprint from roadmap history when active state or an explicit sprint branch is available.
Preserve every execution tied for newest when timestamps cannot distinguish them.
Treat optional store mutations as negotiated capabilities and require them only when a transition is actually pending.
Fail post-merge closeout before writing memories, retro evidence, or sprint state.
yardage_book_updates: Pass SLOPE_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_ID into workflow command subprocesses so terminal validation can preserve its caller.
Close only executions still running; never overwrite paused or failed state.
Route post-merge evidence and store access through the repository state owner.
course_management_notes: The next roadmap sprint is S264, defining the Team Round domain and scoring contract for #669.
